problem: Parallel development was fast at code creation but slow at delivery because each branch/PR created its own CI fan-out, stale merge-bases accumulated, zero-run heads waited silently, and Required plus BRAIN duplicated broad suites.
root_cause: PRs were being used as the primary parallelism unit instead of isolated agent workspaces feeding a bounded integration lane.
Broad regression suites were in the blocking path even when the changed delta did not touch those risk surfaces.
Superseded runs, stale merge-bases and silent workflow starts were treated as waiting states instead of recoverable delivery incidents.
fix: Use isolated parallel agent workspaces but one rolling integration candidate per conflict contract.
Expand safe TURBO scope to 24 files while keeping protected infrastructure/security/schema surfaces excluded.
Make BRAIN reuse the same TURBO risk classification instead of duplicating full suites for safe deltas.
Move unrelated broad assurance to an asynchronous post-merge main workflow.
Set explicit first-signal, turbo and standard latency SLOs and make breaches trigger same-lineage recovery.
Auto-cancel superseded runs and preserve tested candidates across non-overlapping main drift.
